quotes.text: The future belongs to those who show up before it arrives.
quotes.author: Mira Voss

quotes.text: You do not find meaning; you forge it from the raw material of every day.
quotes.author: Unknown

quotes.text: A machine can repeat a pattern. A person can break one.
quotes.author: K. Aletheia

quotes.text: Resistance is not always the enemy — sometimes it is the shape of the lesson.
quotes.author: J. Ren

quotes.text: We are what we repeatedly attend to, not what we pretend to notice.
quotes.author: T. Reinhart

quotes.text: To be outstanding is to be willing to be misunderstood for long stretches of time.
quotes.author: E. Salazar

quotes.text: The world does not owe you coherence. Build one anyway.
quotes.author: Unknown

quotes.text: Distance is a decision, not a measurement.
quotes.author: a. rahman

quotes.text: What you tolerate in silence becomes your new ceiling.
quotes.author: Mira Voss

quotes.text: The deepest form of freedom is the refusal to wait for permission.
quotes.author: L. Candela

quotes.text: Patience without direction is just decoration.
quotes.author: K. Aletheia

quotes.text: Every shortcut asks for a toll you usually do not see until later.
quotes.author: T. Reinhart
